description: This file defines the class FixedLengthRowBasedKeyValueBatch, which implements a batch data structure for key-value records with fixed length in Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst module. It includes methods for appending rows, retrieving key and value rows, and iterating over the records.

classes.name: FixedLengthRowBasedKeyValueBatch
classes.description: A final class implementing a batch of fixed-length key-value records, optimized for fast appending and retrieval within Apache Spark.

methods.name: appendRow
methods.description: Appends a key-value pair into the batch, copying data into the memory block and returning an UnsafeRow pointing to the value.

methods.name: getKeyRow
methods.description: Retrieves the key row at a specified index, reusing the UnsafeRow object for efficiency.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Retrieves the value row associated with a given key row index.

methods.name: rowIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator to traverse all key-value records in the batch.
